Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to recognize conflicting information between authoritative sources and prematurely concluded that George V’s birth year was 1866 based solely on Britannica’s erroneous data. While earlier sources (Wikipedia and Biography.com) consistently cited the correct year (1865), the Planner trusted Britannica without verifying this discrepancy against prior findings or cross-referencing additional reliable sources. This resulted in propagating incorrect information to the final answer.
